# anthropic_compliance_organization_users (Data Source)

Lists the active members of one linked organization from the compliance directory. Removed users disappear immediately. Requires the `read:compliance_user_data` scope. Requires `compliance_api_key` (a Compliance Access Key) or an `enterprise_api_key` carrying the `read:compliance_org_data` scope; Admin API keys are rejected.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_compliance_organization_users" "example" {
  organization_uuid = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001"
}

output "admins" {
  value = [for u in data.anthropic_compliance_organization_users.example.users : u.email if u.organization_role == "admin"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_uuid` (String) Organization UUID (see `anthropic_compliance_organizations`).

### Read-Only

- `users` (Attributes List) Members sorted by join date. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Join timestamp.
- `email` (String) Email address.
- `full_name` (String) Full name.
- `id` (String) User id (`user_...`).
- `organization_role` (String) Built-in membership role (`user`, `admin`, `owner`, ...), independent of RBAC roles.
